package.description: Self-hosted and scalable music streaming, designed for humans.

en-US.description: Self-hosted and scalable music streaming, designed for humans.
en-US.longDescription: UniRhy is a self-hosted music streaming platform organized as a monorepo with separated backend, frontend, and website projects. It aims to provide deployable and extensible music library management, playback, and synchronization capabilities, with cross-platform clients for the web, macOS, Windows, Android and iOS.
en-US.name: UniRhy

zh-CN.description: 自托管、可扩展的音乐流媒体平台。
zh-CN.longDescription: UniRhy 是一个自托管的音乐流媒体平台，采用前后端与官网分离的 monorepo 组织方式，旨在提供可部署、可扩展的音乐库管理、播放与同步能力，并提供 Web、macOS、Windows、Android 与 iOS 跨平台客户端。
